subject: Air freight quote request: FRA to KUL
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from FRA to KUL (Kuala Lumpur, MY)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-29, and we will deliver it to Frankfurt Airport (FRA) ourselves.

The shipment consists of 2 pieces of spare parts for packaging machines, with a gross weight of 1141 kg and a total volume of 10.73 cbm.

Please include the all-in price in EUR, the earliest available departure, and the expected arrival at KUL.

Thank you for your assistance.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specific shipment from FRA to KUL.
